data.animaCaption: Guarding opposite exits in the shadowed safehouse, Ayachi Nene on the left in a charcoal trench coat and thigh holster holds her silver pistol by the blinds while Shiki Natsume on the right in a matte-black trench listens intently at the steel door. Cyan rainlight stripes and a faint red alert lamp slice dramatically across both silhouettes.
data.promptProse: Captured in a taut cinematic tilted wide shot inside a darkened safehouse hallway, Ayachi Nene and Shiki Natsume cover opposite approaches in seamless partnership. On the left, Nene crouches near the shuttered blinds in a charcoal belted trench coat parted over her burgundy turtleneck and leather thigh holster, silver handgun raised and ready; on the right, Natsume presses close to the steel exit door in a matte-black high-collar trench coat and leather gloves with her hand poised on a suppressed pistol. Cold cyan bars of rainy streetlamp light collide with a low crimson alert glow across the corridor.
data.story: 走廊外传来电梯停靠的提示音。宁宁立刻持枪贴紧左侧百叶窗死角，夏目则俯身倾听右侧铁门外的动静；两道风衣身影在红蓝暗光里背靠背默契对视一眼，同时扣开了保险。
